posts.text: Trading & Investing friendly Tax Simulator — Has anyone seen a calculator on Old vs New regime considering various levels of F&O income, STCG and LTCG etc. Everywhere I am seeing only basic income interest related simulations and articles, even online calculators only have salary, interest, house income etc input fields no where for users to input STCG, LTCG, FnO, business income etc. May be the Quicko or Zerodha team or one of the Tech bros in the forum can come up with one, it’ll help quite a lot of people as interest in trading and investing grows in India…
